new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us
Altro powers the next generation of wellness businesses with clinical infrastructure built for growth.


We're building a platform that enables wellness businesses to offer clinical services they currently can't provide on their own, including blood testing, prescriptions, and peptides, supervised by a clinical team. Think Shopify for wellness businesses.


The team behind Altro has done this before: Harvard Business School MBAs and a second\-time founder, alongside operators and executives who've taken startups through exits as founding\-team members. We're backed by top venture capital firms.


The tailwinds are massive: Peptides going mainstream, GLP\-1s unlocking the category, the longevity movement in full swing, and AI unlocking what wasn't possible a year ago.


We're still early. Which means every hire matters. Join at the ground floor, work directly with the founders, and be part of something rare: a company at the intersection of a massive market shift and the moment when AI is reshaping what small teams can build.


The Role
We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer to build Altro's platform alongside our CTO and founders. This is a full\-stack role with a front\-end lean. You'll spend most of your time crafting the consumer and partner\-facing interfaces that operators and their clients touch every day, while still owning the backend work needed to ship features end\-to\-end.


You'll work directly with our CTO — an experienced healthtech engineer who's built and scaled products through multiple acquisitions and mentors engineers in a top AI Masters program. He'll be your manager, your code reviewer, and your mentor.


What You'll Do* Build the interfaces customers see and touch. Consumer, partner\-facing, and clinician\-facing portals — polished, fast, intuitive. UX matters here.
* Own features end\-to\-end. From fuzzy problem ("operators want X") to shipped product (the page, the API, the migration, the analytics) — all of it.
* Work full\-stack, with most of your day in the front end and the rest in the backend services that power what you're building.
* Partner closely with our designer to ship polished UI. You care about the difference between "it works" and "it feels great to use."
* Leverage AI tooling throughout the SDLC — write, review, and deploy with AI where it helps. Speed matters. So does quality.
* Work across a small cross\-functional team — clinical ops, product, design, sales. No throwing things over the wall.
* Engineer for simplicity. Bias toward minimal dependencies, boring technology where it matters, and architecture that scales without ceremony.


How We Work* Ship often. We deploy daily, instrument what matters, and fix forward.
* Boring foundations, exciting features. Proven technology for the core so we can experiment freely at the edges.
* Customers first. Every decision starts with the operator, clinician, or consumer using what we build.
* Real ownership. You touch the whole stack and see the impact of your work in the business, fast.
* Low ego. We hire people who care about the work, not the optics.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Who You Are* 4\-7 years writing production software. Quality and ownership matter more than years.
* Deep TypeScript \+ React/Next.js fluency. You've shipped complex, polished interfaces and think about component architecture, state management, performance, and accessibility.
* Strong design sensibility. You can take a Figma file and ship something that feels exactly right — and push back when something could be better.
* A modern typed backend language in production. You're not a front\-end specialist; you can build the API your front\-end consumes.
* API design experience (GraphQL, REST), schemas, contracts, versioning.
* Comfortable with a cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure configuration.
* A track record of owning features end\-to\-end, not just pieces.
* Clear writing and strong async communication — critical for a small team moving fast.
* High agency. You spot what needs to be built, scope it, build it, ship it. You don't wait for a perfect spec.


Nice to Have* GraphQL at real scale (schema design, performance, tooling)
* Animation libraries (Framer Motion, GSAP) or advanced CSS/Tailwind work
* Design system experience — building or maintaining one
* Comfort with tracing, metrics, and structured logs

  

**Benefits**  

  

Why This Role
This is a founding\-team\-caliber seat at a seed\-stage company with real momentum and one of the strongest tailwinds in healthtech. You'll work directly with a CTO who's built and scaled healthtech products through multiple acquisitions, founders with deep operating experience, and a team small enough that your decisions matter. You'll own real product surface — not slivers.


If you want a front\-row seat to building a company from the very early phases, this is that seat.


Logistics* Location: New York City (Midtown)
* Schedule: Hybrid — 2\-3 days in\-office, remainder remote
* Reports to: CTO


Compensation \& Benefits* Base salary: $170,000 – $200,000, depending on experience
* Equity: Meaningful founding\-team equity grant
* Health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision (100% covered by Altro)
* Unlimited PTO
* Commuter benefits
* One Medical membership
* Peloton Digital membership
* Learning and development budget
* $150 monthly reimbursement for Altro products
